notes: Read all 80 source lines line by line before editing. The module is a self-contained 'don't ask me again' allowlist for confirm dialogs; it imports nothing and its ONLY browser-only dependency is `localStorage`, used as a single versioned key-value slot (web L23 getItem, L35 setItem, L73 removeItem).

L1-18 the top-of-file design/caller-contract comment block (purpose of the silenceKey allowlist, the 'one key, one set, one schema version' rationale, the `:v1` migration suffix note, and the 'treat keys as stable namespaced action ids / do NOT silence danger-variant or typed-confirmation prompts' caller contract) is preserved verbatim. A leading `//` native-port header was prepended above it documenting the localStorage -> in-memory Map substitution, the dropped cold-restart persistence, and that no DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/web-UI modules are imported.
L19 `const STORAGE_KEY = 'teslasync:confirm-silence:v1'` preserved byte-identical (the persisted key value is unchanged so the schema/version semantics carry over).

Native-safe storage substitution (no web line): a module-scoped `const silenceStore = new Map<string, string>()` is added as the native analogue of the single browser localStorage slot, mirroring the established precedent (useKioskMode.ts kioskConfigStore, useChartLegendState.ts nativeLegendStorage, useVehiclePaint.ts overrideStore). React Native has no localStorage; the allowlist persists for the current app process only — cold-restart persistence is the sole behavioral loss, the same single-process degradation those sibling ports document.

L21-31 `load()` ported 1:1: `localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)` -> `silenceStore.get(STORAGE_KEY)` (returns `string | undefined`; the existing `if (!raw) return new Set()` guard handles undefined exactly as it handled localStorage's null/empty-string). The JSON.parse, `Array.isArray(parsed)` guard, the `parsed.filter((v): v is string => typeof v === 'string')` Set construction, and the try/catch -> `new Set()` fallback are preserved verbatim. The `Set<string>` return annotation contextually types each `new Set()` as `Set<string>` (identical to web).

L33-40 `save(set)` ported 1:1: `localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify([...set]))` -> `silenceStore.set(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify([...set]))`. The try/catch with its 'quota exceeded / private mode / no storage — silently skip, worst case re-prompt' comment is preserved verbatim (the try/catch is retained for 1:1 structural fidelity even though Map.set will not throw — matching the useKioskMode precedent that kept try/catch around Map ops).

L42-46 `isSilenced(key)` exported function ported verbatim: empty-key short-circuit `if (!key) return false` + `load().has(key)`, including the JSDoc. Public signature `(key: string): boolean` unchanged.

L48-55 `silence(key)` exported function ported verbatim: empty-key guard, `load()`, `if (s.has(key)) return` idempotency check, `s.add(key)`, `save(s)`, including the JSDoc. Public signature `(key: string): void` unchanged.

L57-63 `unsilence(key)` exported function ported verbatim: empty-key guard, `load()`, the `if (!s.delete(key)) return` (skip save when nothing was removed), `save(s)`, including the JSDoc. Public signature `(key: string): void` unchanged.
L65-68 `listSilenced()` exported function ported verbatim: `[...load()].sort()` returning the sorted action-id array, including the JSDoc. Public signature `(): string[]` unchanged.

L70-77 `clearAllSilenced()` exported function ported 1:1: `localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY)` -> `silenceStore.delete(STORAGE_KEY)` inside the preserved try/catch with its 'same defensive ignore as save — a failed clear is recoverable' comment and JSDoc.
L79-80 `export const _STORAGE_KEY_INTERNAL = STORAGE_KEY` test-only escape hatch preserved verbatim, including its JSDoc; trailing newline preserved.

Code style matches the native prettier config (singleQuote, trailingComma:'all', arrowParens:'avoid' — the only arrow `(v): v is string => ...` is an annotated type-guard whose parens prettier keeps).
